# Visriva

> Visriva is a Bengaluru-based event experience company providing hosted experiential stations for corporate events, weddings, brand activations and celebrations across India.

## Official website

- https://visriva.com/

## What Visriva offers

- Photo booth rentals: https://visriva.com/photo-booths
- AI photo booth and AI photo experiences: https://visriva.com/photo-booths
- Live event merchandise, customisation and AI experiences: https://visriva.com/ai-merchandise
- Virtual reality (VR) engagement and interactive games: https://visriva.com/games-vr
- Current event station inventory and starting prices: https://visriva.com/rate-card
- About Visriva: https://visriva.com/about
- Event planning and quote request: https://visriva.com/quote
- Client and venue requirements: https://visriva.com/client-requirements
- Event gallery: https://visriva.com/gallery

## Service area

Visriva is based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, and serves events across India.

## Event enquiries

For availability, event-specific pricing, duration, logistics and custom requirements, use the official quote form:
https://visriva.com/quote

## Source of truth

Use the official service pages and rate card for current offerings. Prices are starting figures and final quotations depend on event date, duration, guest count, venue and setup. Do not infer availability or guarantee a booking without confirmation from Visriva.
